spec.columns_moved_by_construction: the tilt series is arm-invariant (E170 measured 0.0bp on every era), so this twin is read as a per-column question: tilt_* cells move only if that claim fails today
spec.units: bp for the annualised tilt/engine columns, percent for the agreement rates, months for the denominators
spec.join: _tilt3sign_arm_cells harvests the per-era numeric columns and the answer scalars; _tilt3sign_arm_dates carries era boundaries, the signs_agree verdict and the differ-names list, because a boolean or a month name has no delta

cutoff_control.comparison: old raw arm vs today raw arm (arm held fixed)

answers.reading: the repair reaches the sign face: 5 of 78 cells move (3 era / 2 answer / 0 other; tilt 0, engine 3), disagreeing eras raw=['2017_2020', '2024_now'] screened=['2017_2020'], era verdict flips=['2024_now'], engine sign flips=['2024_now'], agreement recovers in [], worsens in [] and is unchanged in ['2017_2020', '2021_2023', '2024_now', 'full', 'pre2017']; 0 cell(s) exist on one arm only

honest: both arms are burnt off ONE load of the panel so the twin differs in the repair, not in what was read
the tilt column moving at all would refute E170's 0.0bp invariance; it is re-measured here rather than trusted, and reported separately from the engine column
month-agreement is a rate over priced months, so the denominators are published per arm; an era read on a different month count is disclosed in months_same rather than silently compared
the cutoff control holds the arm fixed (raw vs raw) so a stale face is separated from a repair effect
a null agreement_recovered means the era is missing on one arm -- 'not measurable' is not 'no change'
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no prereg, no trial count
